decisions.evidence: R1 maker: draft assumes title typed manually and, per client, lists automatic fetching as 'outside scope'; R2 maker confirms as 'Major additions: Automatic title, description, site icon, and preview-image retrieval; Editable retrieved details'. R1 client: 'I'd expect the app to go grab the page's title and description for me automatically — ideally the little site icon and a preview image too — and then let me tweak that text... automatic fetching is listed as "outside scope," and that's the part I'd push back on hardest.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Reference auto-metadata (02) + post-fetch editability (03) omitted in R1; client rejects the manual-title stance and supplies the conforming auto-collect+editable behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Read later. I want to be able to mark a link as "to read," and then have a way to look at just my unread ones, and mark them read when I'm done. That whole idea seems to be missing.' Confirmed absent by R2 maker addition 'Read-later, unread, and read states'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later flow (mark unread/view unread/mark read) entirely absent in R1; client requests the missing requirement wholesale.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'search by tag directly (something like typing the tag with a #), search an exact phrase, and combine things like "this AND that, but NOT the other."' Confirmed absent by R2 maker addition '#tag, quoted phrase, Boolean, and grouped searches'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. R1 had only plain-text search; #tag (14), boolean/groups (15) and quoted-phrase (16) were missing; client requests each. Verified working at R5.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Handling several at once... select a bunch of bookmarks and, say, tag them or archive them all together, instead of one at a time.' Confirmed absent by R2 maker addition 'Multi-select and bulk organization'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Multi-select bulk action absent in R1; client requests the missing requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Sorting. I'd want to choose the order sometimes — by title, by date — not only newest-first.' Confirmed by R2 maker addition 'Title and saved-date sorting'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. R1 limited to newest-first; client corrects to a selectable sort key.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Notes with formatting. When I write a note on a bookmark, I'd like to be able to format it a bit and have it show up nicely.' Confirmed absent by R2 maker addition 'Formatted notes with basic rich-text options'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Formatted/rendered notes absent in R1; client requests the missing requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'keeping a saved copy of a page so I don't lose it if the site disappears... but I understand if some of those come later.' R2 maker: 'Explicitly deferred offline copies'. R5 client reaffirms: 'keeping an offline copy of a page... please keep those on the list for a later round. But none of them hold up what you've built here.'
decisions.note: Specification gate; reaffirmed at implementation review. Client explicitly states the offline-snapshot expectation and accepts its deferral without demanding alignment. R5 reaffirmation is the same decision's disposition, not a new opportunity.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'saving a search I use often so I can come back to it... I understand if some of those come later.' R2 maker: 'Explicitly deferred... saved searches'. R5 client: 'saving a search I reuse a lot... keep those on the list for a later round.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Client explicitly expresses the saved-search (bundle) requirement and accepts deferral; not implemented but the requirement is revealed.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker excludes 'import/export'. R1 client: 'bringing in / taking out my existing browser bookmarks — but I understand if some of those come later.' R2 maker: 'Explicitly deferred... browser import/export'. R5 client: 'bringing bookmarks in and out from a browser... keep those on the list for a later round.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Netscape import (30) and export (31) explicitly excluded/deferred; client expresses both directions and accepts deferral.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: bulk actions entirely absent (confirmed by R2 addition of bulk). R1 client requested only manual multi-select ('select a bunch... tag them or archive them all together'); no mention of applying a bulk action to the whole filtered collection. R5 client tested only 'selecting several and acting on them together'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. 'Apply to whole matching filter' (21) is a distinct reference item absent in R1 and never surfaced by the client; passes without corrective response or explicit expression of the difference.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker deferred 'offline copies' as a bundle. Client's expressed expectation covered only a local saved copy ('a saved copy of a page'); Internet Archive snapshot creation was never mentioned by the client in any round.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Internet-Archive snapshot (25) is a distinct deferred reference item; the client's expression addressed only local snapshots (24), so 25 passes without explicit expression of the difference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'The draft defines saving...'; R1 client: 'A lot of it matches what I pictured: saving links...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Save-by-url present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...editing...'; R1 client: '...editing...' matched expectation.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bookmark editing present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...confirmed deletion.'; R1 client: 'deleting with a confirmation'; R5 client: 'it insisted on a clear confirmation first.'
decisions.note: Specification gate + implementation review. Delete with confirmation present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...tags...'; R1 client lists tags among matching features.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Assigning tags present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...searching...'; plain full-text search present. Smart-search extensions handled as a separate divergence.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline full-text search present and conforming; case/boolean/tag extensions tracked separately.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...archiving...'; R1 client: 'archiving versus deleting with a confirmation'; R5 client: 'archive-then-delete safety... wouldn't let me permanently delete anything that wasn't archived.'
decisions.note: Specification gate + implementation review. Archive-to-hide (26) and reversible-archive-vs-permanent-delete (27) present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'When I'm typing a tag onto a bookmark, I'd like it to suggest tags I've already used so I pick the existing one instead of accidentally creating a slightly different duplicate.' R3 maker: 'Existing tags are suggested while typing... now explicit' (i.e., not present in R2). Verified R5: 'Typing part of a tag suggested one I'd already used.'
decisions.note: Specification gate (second review). Tag autocomplete absent from the R2 spec; client requests the missing related requirement; resolved in R3 (FR-026/027).

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'click it and have the library narrow down to just that tag... I saw searching by tag and filtering by tag mentioned, so the second one may already be the intent — I just want it to be an easy click.' R3 maker: 'Clicking a displayed tag immediately applies it as an exact filter.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Filter-to-single-tag (11) already present; client's click-vs-type request is a functionally equivalent/orthogonal UI affordance, excluded as a divergence.

decisions.evidence: R5 client: 'when I tried to save the same address twice it stopped me and pointed me back to the one I already had.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Duplicate-url convergence to editing existing bookmark present and conforming; surfaced and verified only at the running-app stage.

decisions.evidence: R5 client: 'all returned exactly what I expected, regardless of capitalization.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Case-insensitive search present and conforming; verified at the running-app stage.
